content.text: Oe, BAWIPA koe lunghawilawk dei awh.
A min lahoi kaw awh nateh,
a sak e hno hah tami pueng koe panueksak awh.
Ama koe la sak awh, ama koe la sak laihoi,
a sak e hno kângairu hno pueng hah dei awh.
A min kathoung teh bari awh.
BAWIPA katawngnaw e lungthin teh nawm naseh.
BAWIPA hoi a thaonae hah tawng awh nateh,
a minhmai hah hoehoe tawng awh.
Kângairu hno a sak e hah hoehoe pâkuem awh nateh,
kângairunae hoi a pahni dawk hoi
ka tâcawt e lawkcengnae hah pâkuem awh.
Oe a san Abraham catoun,
nangmouh Jakop catounnaw,
ama ni rawi e lah na o awh.
Ama teh BAWIPA Cathut lah ao teh,
a lawkcengnae ni talai pueng koung a katin.
A lawkkam teh pou a pâkuem teh
se thong totouh nakunghai thoseh,
Abraham koe lawk a kam e hoi
Isak koe thoe a bo e hai thoseh,
kâ a poe e lawk teh a pâkuem.
Hotnaw teh Jakop Catounnaw hanelah,
ka cak e phung lah a sak teh,
Isarel hanelah a yungyoe e lawkkam doeh.
Kanaan ram heh râw lah
na poe han telah lawk a kam.
Tami kayounca lah ao awh lahunnah,
oe kayounca lah imyin lah ka o awh.
Kho touh hnukkhu kho touh,
uknaeram hnukkhu alouke koe a kâva awh.
Ahnimouh rektap hane pasoung hoeh.
Bokheiyah, ahnimouh kecu dawk
siangpahrang hah a yue pouh.
Satui ka awi e naw hah tek awh hanh.
Ka profetnaw hah runae poe hanh telah a ti.
Hothloilah, ram thung takang a tho sak teh,
cang hoi apawhik naw koung a raphoe pouh.
Ahnimae hmalah a patoun awh e,
Joseph teh san patetlah a yo awh.
a khok hlong a buet pouh awh teh,
sumbawtarui hoi a rektap awh.
A dei tangcoung e a kuep hoehroukrak,
BAWIPA ni ahni teh a tanouk.
Hottelah siangpahrang ni a patoun teh a tâco sak teh,
ukkung lah o hanlah a hlout sak.
A imthungkhu kahrawikungnaw a tawn e pueng hoi,
a tami bawinaw yue thainae kâ hoi
kahrawikungnaw lungangnae cangkhai hanelah,
kaukkung lah a coung sak.
Isarel hai Izip ram lah a tho teh,
Jakop hai Ham ram vah ao.
A taminaw moi a pung sak teh,
ahnimouh ka tarannaw hlak
a tha hoe kaawm lah a coung sak.
A taminaw hah a tarannaw ni a hmuhma awh teh,
a sannaw hah huenghai hoi
dumyen hanelah a lungthin a kâhleng sak.
A san Mosi hoi a rawi e
Aron hoi a patoun.
Mitnout hah a taminaw koe a sak teh,
Ham ram dawk kângairu hno hah a sak.
Hmonae hah a tho teh koung a hmo.
Hahoi a lawk teh oun thai awh hoeh.
Ahnimae tui hah thi lah a coung sak teh,
tangawn hah a due sak.
Ahnimae ram teh ekka hoi king akawi teh,
siangpahrang imthung totouh koung akawi.
Lawk a dei boteh bitsei thouk a tâco teh
ahri hai a ram pueng dawk a tâco.
Kho rak yueng lah roun a poe,
a ram dawk hmaito hai a tâco sak.
Misurkung hoi thaibunglung kung
koung a raphoe teh a ram dawk e
thingkungnaw a khoe pouh.
Lawk a dei teh samtongnaw a tho awh teh,
touklek hoeh lah a tho awh.
Hotnaw ni a ram dawk e
apawhik pueng a ca teh,
apawhik pueng hah capingkacailah a ca awh.
A ram dawk e camin pueng hai a raphoe teh,
aluepaw pueng hai koung a raphoe pouh.
Hothloilah, sui hoi ngun hoi a tâco sak teh,
a taminaw thung dawk kabawp han totouh,
ka vout e awm hoeh.
A tâco awh navah, Izipnaw a lunghawi awh.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, ahnimouh hah a taki awh.
Ka ngue hanelah tâmai a pâyam sak teh,
khohmo ka ang sak hanlah hmai hah a poe.
Tamimaya ni a hei awh e tamuem hah a poe teh,
kalvanlae rawca hoi a von a paha awh.
Lungsong a paawng teh, tui a tâco,
kahrawngum palang patetlah a lawng.
Bangtelah tetpawiteh, a san
Abraham koe kathounge a lawkkam hah pahnim hoeh.
A taminaw hah konawm laihoi a hrawi teh,
a rawi e naw hah thadamcalah a hrawi.
A phunglam hah tarawi vaiteh,
kâlawk a tarawi thai awh nahanlah,
Jentelnaw e ram hah a poe teh,
ayâ ni a tawk tangcoung e hah a pang sak.
Hallelujah.
